title: The wall on closed surfaces, and which twists a seam can carry
claim: On every closed orientable surface with a cellularly embedded graph, for every primitive class c and twist q odd on c, an explicit involution maps the orientations whose twisted strong components wind along c and nothing else in twist q onto those in twist q + PD(c), keeping every directed cycle up to a relabelling of sheets; so the two line probabilities are equal under fair orientations. The seams next to a vertex set P (mod-2 cocycles on the edges with one end in P) carry exactly the duals of the classes of curves in the open star of P minus the graph on P; for square tilings that open star retracts onto the graph on P plus a diagonal across each square with exactly two opposite corners in P, so next to a lone odd loop with no such square a seam carries only 0 or PD(c). In three dimensions the same duality involves closed surfaces, and a set whose open star lies in a solid torus carries no seam class. An earlier statement of the seam lemma with the graph on P in place of the open star was false and is corrected.
failure_conditions: An orientation in a line event of a genus-2 surface whose moved digraph has different arcs on directed cycles, whose image is not in the partner line event, or whose image does not map back.
A seam next to a random vertex set whose class is not dual to a class carried by the open star of the set.
A loop confined to a tube of the 5 x 5 x 5 torus with a nonzero seam class.
foundation_claim_scope: Twisted double covers of uniform random orientations on closed orientable surfaces and closed 3-manifolds with cell structures; an exact identity and duality statements about seams. Lattices and surfaces are declared; no space or physics is claimed.

validation.status: checked: prose proof; check.py examines 425 distinct orientations from random walks with restarts inside line events of genus-2 L-shaped surfaces (L(2,2,2,2): classes h2 and v2; L(3,1,2,2): class v1) and verifies on every one the wall lemma, that the image lies in the partner line event, that the involution returns, and that the wall realizes PD(c); every seam next to those loops carried only 0 and PD(c). On 300 random vertex sets of L(3,2,2,2) every seam class is dual to a class carried by the open star (graph on P plus diagonals); on 104 of them the graph alone misses some. On 200 loops in a 2 x 2 tube of the 5 x 5 x 5 torus only the zero seam class occurs. Four controls rejected. No human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with sampled checks
